title: Timeline of Plans to Implement Ban on Domestic Trade in Ivory
what_it_is: Timeline of Plans to Implement Ban on Domestic Trade in Ivory

sections.label: Domestic ivory trade ban timeline
sections.summary: The Minister says AVA is studying a domestic ivory trade ban, engaging stakeholders, and will announce updates when ready.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development whether he can provide an update on the timeline of the Ministry's plans to implement a ban on domestic trade in ivory.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There are many stakeholders to engage, as well as operational details that need to be worked out as part of this study.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA will provide further updates and make an announcement on this matter when ready.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, it will not be so easy to transpose what is practicable in another jurisdiction to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But if the Member is concerned about the proliferation of the ivory trade, be assured that, actually, since the prohibition and international ban in 1990, there are no commercial import and export of ivory in Singapore unless there are explicit permits given by AVA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, this current review pertains to how we want to even tackle any pre-Convention stocks that are in Singapore to be managed by domestic businesses.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And I think as we engage the local businesses, we hope to be able to make the announcements soon.
